(oṃ)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul bzhugs/ /༈/na mo gu ru rat+na war+dha ya/'jam mgon grub dbang mkhas mchog brgyud par ba

tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru rat+na war+dha ya/ 'jam mgon grub dbang mkhas mchog brgyud par bcas// 'jam dbyangs ma he'i zhal dngos ngag dbang rje// 'jam dbyangs thugs rje'i mnga' bdag shes rab mtshan// drin chen bla ma rnam bzhi spyi bos mchod// yid dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus btud nas// dam pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi'i chu gter las// mkha' spyod bsnyen thabs dgos 'dod nor bu che// don gnyer klu dbang gtsug rgyan 'di spel lo// de la 'dir nā ro mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa byed thabs ni/ chas ka gnas khang*/ mtshams g.yog sogs lhus thengs byas/ gza' skar ram dus bzang ba la/ byi ba sogs kyis skyon mi yong ba'i stegs bur gtor ma gcig gam gzhan chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma gang dgos dang*/ kha gso'i mtheb kyu dang bcas pa bshams/ nang mchod yod na nang mchod dang*/ med na chab kyis bran/ gdan 'og tu g.yam pa la sogs la dkar chus rdo rje rgya gram bris la gzhug cha gsum shes na logs shig tu chos srung 'jig rten skyong ba/ gzhi bdag gnod byed thams cad la dmigs nas cha gsum yid ches nges shes pa gcig btang na'ang legs pa tsam yin zhing ma byas na skyon med/ de nas rang nyid mal du bsdad nas/ thog mar bka' drin che ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod brgyud 'debs sogs ci rigs byas/ de nas dkon mchog gsum la blo gtod 'chol ba dang*/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la dmigs nas bsnyen pa byed snyam pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems dang 'dres nges pa brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ yig brgya nyer gcig tsam dang sgrub thabs bskyed chog rnams dmigs pa gsal nges byas/ rang nyid kyis sngags 'dren pa bzhin dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can lus kyi srin bu tshun thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal bas/ sngags kyi sgra di ri ri 'dren par bsams la/

snying ga'i sngags glog pa'i tshul gyis oṃ gsum ma brgya'am lnga brgya la sogs pa ji rigs pa bgrang*/ mjug gi zhar byung rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag rnams shar sgom gyi tshul du byas nas gtor bsngo gang shes rnams byas rjes nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ sang nyin gnyid sad ma thag ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsal gdab bdud rtsi dngos su myang ba'am gsal ba gang rung bya/ yang skyabs 'gro brgya tshar tsam dang yig brgya nyer gcig sogs zhag bdun tsam gyi bar du snga thun la byas na legs/ rgyun du dal brel dang bstun nas byas pas chog la/ gong ltar thun bzhi byed na snga thun nyi ma shar tsam dang*/ thun gsum ma byed na/ tho rangs thun sngags gang 'gro byas rjes/ 'dir rang gi gtor bsngo sogs mjug gi bya ba rnams byas/ lto zas tshar ba dang chag med gzhan dgos pa rnams snga dgong skabs su gang babs sogs la byed/ nyi ma phyed tsam nas nyi ma rgas bar thun bya ste/ dgong thun mjug tu gtor bsngo rgyas pa byed/ yang nyi ma rgas mtshams nas srod ji ltar 'os pa byas nas/ mjug gtor bsngo'i bar sngar bzhin byas rjes/ sngar bzhin nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal ba dang*/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor pas thun byed tshul sogs gong bzhin byas pa'i/ oṃ gsum ma 'bum tsho bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa'am/ rgyas par 'bum tsho sum cu so lnga byed par bshad do// rgyas bsdus gnyis gang byed kyang mtshams dang nas 'dra zhes pa mgo mjug gnyis lhod tsam byas/ gung la gang 'jur gyis stan drod ma yal ba byed cing*/ yang brel ba che ba dang*/ nad lta bu byung yang thun ma chag tsam cis kyang bya dgos la/ bsnyen pa'i grangs song nas sbyin sreg byed na/ rje rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi dpe sogs yig cha khungs thub gang rigs kyi steng nas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 'bul zhing*/ sngags kyang byung na oṃ gsum ma rang gis 'bul/

de yun ring nas cha rkyen mi 'grigs na/ mgo mjug gnyis su oṃ gsum ma tshar re dang*/ gzhan rdzas sngags kho na brjod kyang go chod par gsungs la/ gang ltar yang sbyin sreg gi grangs song nas/ thal ba grang thag chod pa dang bsdus te/ chu'am/ ri mtho sar bskyal/ rang nyid mtshams je lhod du grib dang 'gris su bcug pa'am/ yang na thun gyi mjug tu gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang bcas te mtshams grol bar bya'o// bzlas pa'i nang na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i oṃ gsum 'di shin tu phan yon che ste/ bsgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bye ba bdun cu yod pa bsdu na bye ba bzhir 'dus pa la/ de yang bsdu na stong phrag bzhir 'du/ de yang bsdu na snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas par 'du/ de thams cad bsdu na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di gcig pur 'dus shing*/ sngags kyang oṃ gsum ma brjod pas yul nyer bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs so// de ltar bsnyen sgrub byas pa'i phan yon yang*/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang rang gtso mo// mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir// sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod// dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na// thos pa tsam gyis 'ong bar 'gyur// de bzhin skad cig sangs rgyas gshegs// zhes dang*/ rgyud gzhan las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// zhes gsungs so// de ltar byas pas ma rgyud yum skor man chad kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi las rnams la dbang ba yin no// yang sngon du bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum tsam song zin nas lo mtshams sogs bsgrub bsnyen gyi sgo nas thugs dam 'di la 'bad stsol byed na/ snga thun dgong thun gnyis re byas/ thun mtshams la gzhan dgos pa rnams bya/ 'bru 'bum mam bye bsnyen nam dung phyur sogs byas na shin tu legs/

de ltar nā ro mkha' spyod sgrub thabs 'di/ kun dga' lhun grub sogs dge bshes 'gas bskul ba'i ngor/ a wa ḍā rgyud sde'i pho brang du bla ma'i bran ngag dbang bsod nams kyis bris pa'o// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan gyi mthus// drin chen mar gyur 'gro drug sems can kun// gnas skabs tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*// mkha' spyod bgrod nas don gnyis lhun grub shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ ma lus rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje chos// ma rig la 'khon sa skya'i 'jam mgon dang*// ma nor lam ston drin can mkhyen rab rjer// ma yengs sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu 'dud// gang zhig dran pas snying gi gdung ba sel// brtson pas bsgoms na tshe 'dir phyag chen gyi// dngos grub stsol mdzad bdag gi yi dam lha// mkha' spyod dbang mo snying dbus pad+mor byon// mchog thun dngos grub myur du thob pa dang*// dang po'i las can lam la slob pa'i thabs// thabs mchog mkha' spyod ma dpal bsnyen pa'i tshul// tshul lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres 'dir bshad bya// de la 'dir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po 'di'i byin rlabs dang 'khrid sogs legs par thob cing chag med kyi rgyun dang ldan pas/ gang du bya ba'i gnas ni dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa'i dgon gnas lta bu/ rang gi gnas yid du 'ong ba steng shod bar gsum thams cad du rang dbang 'du ba'i sgrub khang du 'byor na bla bres yol ba sogs bkod pa mdzes pa'i zhal shar lho lta bu ji ltar bde bar rje btsun ma'i bris sku 'bur sku sogs mchog gsum gyi rten yod na bshams/ de'i mdun du stegs bang rim can sogs gos kyis bkab pa'i steng ma la rgyun du chag med byed bzhin pa yin na gtor ma lnga tshar sogs ji tsam dgos pa dang*/ chag med mi byed na rje btsun ma'i gtor ma sku bag sha chang sogs/

dang 'brel ba zlum po pad+ma 'dab bzhis bskor ba mar dkar gyi khu bas byugs pa la mar gyis brgyan ci mdzes pas spras pa dang*/ sgos kyi chos skyong dur bdag sogs kyi gtor ma mthong brgyud kyi phyag len bzhin rgyan ldan/ de thams cad la rdul gyi gnod pa sogs kyis mi gos pa'i gtor khang lta bu bya/ mdun gyi rim pa 'og ma'i steng du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang bcas pa bkod pa ci mdzes su bshams/ gnas khang gi stabs 'grigs na nges par rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa dgos te/ rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu ti'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs su/ rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas su kha bltas te 'dug la zhes pa'i gong mchan du/ rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas ni o rgyan te kha nub tu bltas la/ zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun rin po ches zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs su/ stan bde ba la kha nub tu bltas te 'dug nas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ci nas stabs ma 'grigs na kha shar la sogs par bltas kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang stan gyi 'og tu rdo rje'i ri mo bris pa'i steng du 'bras nas sogs bkram pa'i steng du stan dang sngas nang tshangs can mtshams ma grol bar du bsgul bskyod mi dgos par byas/ rang gi mdun nam g.yas g.yon gang bder cog rtse la sogs pa'i steng du dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu/ me tog 'thor snod rdza rdo la sogs pa'i thod gzugs kyi nang du chang la bu ram dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab ba kheb dang bcas pa/ thod pa ltag sprod kyi ḍā ma ru sogs sta gon bya/ rang gi bza' btung gi yo byad dang gos sogs kyang 'dangs nges shes pa'i nyer bsdogs dang*/ dgon sde lta bu'i dkor skal kyang slong mi dgos na rab yin gsung*/ mtshams g.yog kyang lnga drug dmigs khong du bcug cing 'phral du gcig las mang ba mi bya zhing*/ lha rje yang dmigs khong du chud par bya dgos te/ de rnams nyer bsdogs legs par bsgrubs nas/

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la nam bya ba'i dus ni/ rgyud las/ tshes bcu la ni de rab brjod// zhes gsungs pas tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar ngo dang*/ sdig pa sbyang bar 'don na mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rung la/ de ma byung na bla ma gong ma'i dus chen sogs dang*/ gza' skar 'grigs pa'i mar ngo'i tshes grangs bzang ba'i nyin snga dro bshams rnams grub par byas/ phyi ma red kyi dus la grogs dam tshig pa 'ga' zhig dang bcas cha gsum zhig btang*/ bgegs gtor phyir dor ba'i tshe sems kyi dmigs pa bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i bar chad byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyangs ring du bskrad par bsam zhing*/ bla ma gong ma'i ljags gul gyi dud pa dang thun sogs kyis brab/ thun gyi ngo gsum bzhi gang bder mdzad kyang thun bzhi ma nyid bde zhing legs par 'gyur ro// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i don// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir thun gyi thog mar dgong thun nas bya dgos pas sgrub khang gi nyi ma ma nub pa'i sngon du cha gsum gyi sgrub grogs sogs phyir song mtshams sgo'i phyi rol du mtho brtan par brtsigs la sa dkar gyis bran bskyed chog byas te/ brtan bzhugs kyi me tog gtor/ de nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen sgrub bya snyam pa/ de yang dus tshod 'di tsam las grub par bya snyam pa'i tur tur po mi bya ba yun ji tsam 'gor kyang legs snyam pa'i dga' spro dang ldan pas/ thog mar rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ rang la bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bstod pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bya/ de nas skyabs yul legs par gsal btab ste skyabs 'gro bzhi skor tshig dang dmigs pa ma bral ba'i sgo nas brgya tsam dang sems bskyed gsum la sogs pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung byas nas bla ma bstim pa'i rkyen gyis rje btsun ma bskyed/

lus dkyil gsol 'debs yo ga shud+dho3'i bar dmigs pa ma yengs par nyams su blangs/ des bzlas pa la 'jug pa'i sngon du dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i thod pa'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa'am yang na sam+bhu ṭa las/ zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la// bho dhi rtses ni las kun byed// ces gsungs pa ltar bho dhi rtse'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi grangs ldan lag pa'i bar du bzung ste/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dzñā naṃ ma sarba bud+dhu ma yaṃ bha be ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas pa'i kha rlangs phreng bar phog par byas te byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pas bzung la/ dmigs pa ni rang gi snying khar lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig sngags phreng kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sgra dag cing gsal bar tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par brgya stong tsam bzlas/ de nas yid bzlas dang rdzogs rim skabs dang sbyar/ bsam gyis mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa nyams len gyi gtso bo yin pas ma chag par nan tan bya/ 'di rnams kyi ngag 'don tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin bya ste/ sgrub khang gi nyi ma nub pa dang thun bsdus la gtor bsngo rgyas pa chag med byed bzhin yin na skabs 'dir bya zhing*/ byed bzhin pa min na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gtor bsngo dang*/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo byas la chag med gzhan bya dgos na yang 'dir bya/

dgong mi bsrung na bza' btung yang byas te/ yang sngar bzhin gsol 'debs nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar byas la gnyid mi bro na bzlas pa srod ma yol ba sogs bya zhing*/ de nas bsam mi khyab kyi mjug bsdu ba'am bar du bir srung sogs byed na dang mi byed na nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gsal btab la nyal/ sang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang bdud rtsi myang ba byas te gsol 'debs nas bzlas pa'i bar sgrub khang la nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du bya zhing nyi ma 'char khar thun bsdus te rje btsun ma dang dur khrod bdag po'i gtor ma gsos la gtor bsngo byas la tsha bzhes sogs byas/ de nas gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs dgos na skabs 'dir byas/ lus sbyangs sogs shes na dang ma shes na brgya phyag bskor ba ci 'grub la 'bad/ yang gsol 'debs nas bzlas pa'i bar gung ma zin bar dang*/ gung zin nas sngar ltar thun bsdus la gtor bsngo sogs kyi mjug tu gung tshig bya zhing cung zhig ngal bso/ yang sngar ltar nyi ma nub kyi bar du bya zhing*/ de nas gtor bsngo bya ba rigs 'gre'o// gang ltar zhag gsum tsam gyi bar bla ma'i gsol 'debs skyabs 'gro sogs brgya rtsa tsam dang rgyun du lnga bcu nyer gcig sogs ci nus las ha cang mang na sngags kyi dngos gzhi'i grangs la gnod pas rgyas bsdus 'tshams par byas/ yang chag med kyi rigs dkar cha bzhi lta bu ni thor thun gyi gong dang*/ lam dus ni thor thun grol nas snga thun ma tshugs pa'i bar du bya zhing gzhan chung ba'i rigs rnams thun mtshams gang byung la byas pas chog de yang thun gyi sgang la ja phran bu tsam las gzhan bza' btung gi rigs gtan nas mi byed/ gung seng yang chab rdog lta bur byed/ smra bcad kyang byung na rgyun du bya ste de ltar ma grub tshe thun gyi sgang la tha mal smra brjod gtan nas mi byed/ dmigs pa yang sngar bshad pa de dang ma bral ba dang*/ des dub par gyur na res sngags kyi sgra la sems gtad/

res spyan nas me ri'i bar la sems gtad pa sogs mdor na sems skad cig kyang ma yengs pa gal che ste/ gzhan du 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams kyi ngang nas ji tsam bzlas kyang phan yon mi 'byung ste/ mgon po zhi ba lhas/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub dag /yun ring dus su 'bad byas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yengs pas bzlas pa ni// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir thun mtshams rnams su yang tha mal du nam yang ma shor ba'i lus lha ngag sngags yid rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis dran 'dun dang ma bral bar bya/ na tsha sogs phran bu dang bde sdug gi rigs ci byung yang bla ma dkon mchog la blos bkal ba'i gang yong ba shog snyam pa las sems 'tshab tshub mi bya/ phyogs nas yi ge lta bu'i rigs byung na stan thog de ma yin pa zhig nas kha phye zhing lan yang de nas bya dgos/ thun gyi sgang la mi dgos kha med kyi 'phros pa dgos tshe sam ṭa lta bu la bri ba las gzhan mtshams ral ba'i nyes par 'gyur gsungs/ bzlas pa'i grangs ni gzhi'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi/ khri phrag bzhi/ stong phrag bzhi/ brgya phrag bzhi rnams kyi don 'grub par gsungs shing*/ 'bru 'bum byed na 'bum phrag so bdun mdzad pa phyag len yin la/ gang ltar yang gzhi bsnyen tsam la ni dal brel snyoms par byas na zla ba gcig dang zhag bcu skor la 'gro bas thog mar tshugs 'phral brel drags na dngos gzhi la gnod pas/ thog ma dang tha mar dal zhing bar du brel ba bsnyen pa nas 'dra ma bya gsungs/ de ltar grangs thebs pa dang grub na zhag gnyis gsum gyi bar sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bya zhing 'dir ma grub kyang nyes pa cher med/ gang ltar dam tshig pa gcig gnyis sogs dang rim gyis 'phrad/ thun thams cad kyi mjug tu mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs bsngo smon ci shes dgos/ dge rtsa sangs rgyas su bsngo bar bya ba gal che'o// gsum pa mjug ni/

gnas khang de nyid dam de kha'i phyi sogs phyi sgo tshun gyi bde ba'i sar dpe ris bzhin thig btab la/ yod byad sogs phyag len ltar bshams/ cho ga dngos ni rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas bya zhing*/ grangs ni rgyud las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas ma 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// gsang sngags 'bum phrag dag la ni// sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar lha sngags oṃ gsum ma dang rdzas til 'ba' zhig la grangs khri phrag bzhi bya dgos te kha bskang lha sngags kho na dgos pa/ rjes mus chen gyis bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po la nan tan du gsungs pa ltar kha'u brag rdzong pa'i phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'o// de lta bu nyin gsum bzhi gang 'grub kyi bar byas la/ de'i sang nyin lta bur gtor 'bul rgyas pa byas la/ gtang rag bya ste dga' ston la rol bar bya'o// dpal mo mkha' spyod ma dpal bsnyen pa'i tshul// dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya 'di// pha rgod bla ma'i gsung gi nying khu rnams// brjod par 'phong ste yi ge'i phreng bar spel// rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ pha bla ma mkhyen rab rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhabs rdul yun ring du brten cing gsung gi bdud rtsis skal ba bzang po gyur pa'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung lhun grub kyis rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la sman pa'i phyir/ thub bstan rwa ba smad kyi chos grwar sug bris su bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
